messages:
Priya: Heads-up: external pentest booked Wed 2026-04-01 09:00-17:00 UTC. Need an RBAC freeze window, KMS access plan (no raw key sharing), immutable audit snapshot, and an evidence packaging owner. Who can own what?

Dave: I can take RBAC freeze + rollback runbook. Propose freeze 08:45-17:30 UTC so we have pre/post windows. I'll list affected service accounts.

Maria: For KMS we'll use a proxy pattern — grant kms:Decrypt via ephemeral assessor role, never hand over key material. Need assessors' AWS account IDs and S3 prefixes.

Luis: Assessors: acct 999988887777. We'll publish a manifest with allowed S3 prefixes and read-only actions. Also suggest providing a sha256 manifest of logs for integrity.

Priya: Prefer presigned read-only log bundle + timeboxed snapshot + optional incremental diffs instead of continuous access. That reduces blast radius.

Ops Bot: Created ticket SEC-PT-4523: presigned logs + KMS-proxy + RBAC freeze coordination. Assignees: @Dave, @Maria. ETA: 24h for initial artifacts.

Dave: RBAC preview policy (will lock down to prefixes):

```
{
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

I'll convert to least-privilege and publish per-bucket prefixes.

Maria: KMS policy pattern we intend to use: allow kms:Decrypt with Condition StringEquals kms:ViaService = "s3.amazonaws.com" and aws:SourceAccount = "999988887777". Limits decryption to S3+assessor account.

Priya: Audit requirements: multi-region CloudTrail on, trails delivered to immutable S3 with object lock enabled, and a snapshot export (tar + sha256) of the 08:45-17:30 window. Platform: can you confirm retention and how we'll hand the snapshot off?

Luis: Platform will export a tarball of CloudTrail + filtered host logs for that window, write to pt-evidence/snapshots/1768888888.tar.gz, and publish sha256(.tar.gz) to the readroom manifest. SIEM alert snapshots also included.

Emily: Oncall here. If the assessors trigger noisy scans or cause alerts, we should have a rate-limit plan and an incident bridge. Who's primary for quick triage?

Priya: Dave primary, Maria backup. If a critical finding blocks prod, we escalate to incident bridge and follow runbook. If retest fails, we'll coordinate a 2-business-day re-run window and a remediation sprint.

Dave: :thumbsup: I'll draft the RBAC freeze runbook and do a dryrun Thu morning. Will include a rollback snippet and checklist.

Maria: Please ensure no KMS key rotations are scheduled during the window. Ops — pause rotation jobs for alias/pt-evidence-key.

Ops Bot: Rotation jobs paused for alias/pt-evidence-key from 2026-04-01T07:00Z to 2026-04-01T20:00Z. Added note to SEC-PT-4523.

Priya: Final asks: everyone add a one-line acceptance criterion to SEC-PT-4523 by EOD today (e.g., "Audit snapshot verified + sha256 matches" or "Assessors only have kms:Decrypt via proxy"). We'll do a 15-min pre-walk Tue 10:00 UTC.

Dave: Added: "RBAC freeze applied, runbook tested, retest window agreed."

Maria: Added: "KMS proxy confirmed, no key rotations during window."

Luis: Added: "Log snapshot exported, sha256 published, SIEM snapshot included."

Emily: Added: "Oncall escalation path validated and oncall ops briefed."

Priya: Great — thanks team. Small drywalk Tue, full ops go-nogo Wed 07:30 UTC. If anything changes ping in this thread. :wave:
